finalRoundDispositions.V5F-1: fixed: 'Sono tutti' confirms a number of rows; it cannot be answered while an unread line is pending, and it is asked again when the number of pasted rows changes (a row removed); tests
finalRoundDispositions.V5F-2: fixed: a header typed with ’ (Eta’) is the stated format; corpus case
finalRoundDispositions.V5F-3: fixed: an age/date conflict also offers 'Correggi la data', which moves to the date; an age the operator typed is labelled 'Età inserita'; tests
finalRoundDispositions.V5F-4: fixed: with the telephone off, an age, a word or a date (in the shapes listed under V6-1 to V9-1) in the Telefono column makes the line unread with its value named; a telephone, even malformed, is ignored, except a grouped one that has a date's shape with dots or dashes and a trailing pair (02.12.34 56), which is shown as unread; corpus cases and test
finalRoundDispositions.V5F-5: fixed: the browser journey also fails when any recorded request URL carries a pasted value

acceptance.statedFormatRoundTrips: met: parser-robustness.json, every case of the corpus
acceptance.malformedParsedOrShownUnread: met: parser-robustness.json records 0 silently wrong students; unread lines are shown with their text and reason and are fixed in place or left out explicitly
acceptance.everyRowReviewed: met: every pasted row carries the from-assistant warning and needs its own check; the count must be confirmed
acceptance.promptCopyable: met: one-tap copy with a selectable fallback (browser journey)
acceptance.noNetworkCall: met: the browser journey refuses foreign hosts, non-GET requests and any request URL carrying a pasted value
acceptance.cameraPathFirstAndUnchanged: met: the camera and gallery remain first; the assistant section follows them

closureRoundDispositions.V5C-1: fixed: '-', '–', '—', 'N/D' and 'n.d.' in any optional column count as empty; corpus case
closureRoundDispositions.V6-1: fixed: with the telephone off, a value counts as a telephone only when it has telephone characters, at least four digits, and either nine or more digits or no year in it; corpus case with 2010-03-12, 12 / 03 / 2011 and 12032012
closureRoundDispositions.V8-1: fixed: only a whole value shaped as day, month and year (with dots, slashes, dashes or spaces, the year of two digits or 19xx/20xx), perhaps followed by an age, counts as a date; a telephone written in groups (0789.12.34.56, 02-12-34-56) is ignored again; corpus cases
closureRoundDispositions.V8-2: fixed: a spaced date with a two-digit year (01 02 14) is shown; so with the telephone off, a date in the Telefono column is shown as an unread line when it is written with dots, slashes, dashes or spaces, as an ISO date, or as eight digits with a four-digit year; six digits run together (010214) are still read as a short telephone and ignored; corpus case
closureRoundDispositions.V9-1: fixed: a trailing age is accepted only after a date written with dots, slashes or dashes, so a telephone in space-separated pairs (06 12 34 56) is ignored again; a spaced date followed by an age (01 02 2014 16) is therefore read as a telephone and ignored; corpus case
closureRoundDispositions.V10-1: recorded: V5F-4 now names the grouped telephone shapes that are shown; a spaced date followed by an age (01 02 14 16) is read as a telephone and ignored, as V9-1 states; with the Età column empty the row then needs its age or date typed, so nothing wrong is saved
